meta: What is a token, and why does the same idea in Vietnamese usually use more tokens than English? It means higher API costs and a context window that fills up faster.

muc.title: Vietnamese uses more tokens
muc.text: The same idea written in Vietnamese usually uses more tokens than in English.

muc.title: AI reads in pieces
muc.text: AI doesn't read word by word but piece by piece, and each piece is called a token, as video 19 of the channel explained.

muc.title: Words with tone marks get chopped up
muc.text: Models learn far more English, so Vietnamese words with tone marks often get split into more, smaller pieces.

muc.title: Costs more, remembers less
muc.text: More tokens means using the API costs more, and long conversations fill the context window faster.

muc.title: Count some tokens
muc.text: Paste a Vietnamese paragraph and its English translation into a free token counter, and see which one has more.
